chapter: Joining Earl Hines and the Grand Terrace
title: The Depression and day jobs
summary: Pay at the Grand Terrace depended on Ed Fox's take; he later had a day job.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band

blocks.x: When the Depression hit in '32, what were you doing, and how --
I was at the Grand Terrace then.
Well, don't even mention wages. During the Depression, because it all depended on what Ed Fox took in.
Yeah. Things really got bad, you know. But I made it, you know. It was better than not working at all, you know.

After I left Earl I took a day gig.
